newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide files shelf for $300 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide files shelf for $300 mln debt.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities.
When combined with previous registrations, Union Carbide will have a total offering of $500 million, the filing said.

Net proceeds from the sale of the securities will be used to retire outstanding debt, repurchase outstanding shares of the company's common and otherwise for general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
Union Carbide of Danbury, Conn., is a worldwide chemicals and polymers company with two business segments, Specialties & Intermediates and Basic Chemicals & Polymers.
